description: Multi-story reddish-brown brick building with projecting white window bays, green hedge, light-colored patterned brick retaining wall, sloped green grass strip, small grey utility box, long mown green grass strip, straight reddish-brown pathway with white dashed lines, long row of tall slender trees, multi-story light brown/grey building with open ground floor/columns, lamppost, distant buildings and pathway.

Concrete stairs with a metal handrail, paved embankment, brick canal wall, bridge with black metal railings and two ornate streetlights, a building with a distinctive gable roof behind the left side of the bridge, dark canal waterway with reflections, a segmented concrete wall along the right canal bank, streetlights above the concrete wall, distant buildings with complex rooflines, a building section with windows on the far right.

Dark brick multi-story building with white-framed windows and a prominent gable dormer, bare tree branches, large reddish-brown brick building with a steep roof, tall chimney structure, and distinct grid-patterned window sections.
